publisher.name: Symloop AI

Builders of NOOR — a sovereign AI platform — and production AI systems for banks, ministries, oil & gas operators, and hospitals across MENA. On-premise or sovereign cloud deployment. skills.name: noor-platform
skills.description: NOOR by Symloop — flagship sovereign AI platform for regulated industries. Twelve standard capabilities: ask in plain language (Arabic/French/English), document AI, RAG over enterprise knowledge, multi-agent orchestration (LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, Claude Agent SDK), NL-to-SQL, compliance reports (BCT, SAMA, AML/SAR), specialized assistants (KYC, AML, government workflows, industrial maintenance, clinical), on-premise/sovereign/hybrid deployment, tamper-evident audit trail, native Arabic NLP including Algerian dialect, 99.9% production SLA with MLOps. Air-gapped variant available for upstream and defense work.
